_comment: SG13CMOS5L configuration for the pinned origin layout generator (layout/vendor/sg13g2-stdcells/layout/gen_layouts.py, reuse.lock.json). This repo owns this file; the generator is taken by pinned reference and never edited. Invoke: python3 -I layout/vendor/sg13g2-stdcells/layout/gen_layouts.py --config layout/sg13cmos5l-cells.config.json --out layout/gds. Scope is one cell (issue #151, the retarget probe); the other 39 are issue #24. Nothing here is a measured result: it is generator input, and the GDS it produces is generator output, not a DRC/LVS-clean or manufacturable claim (#25, #26).
_pdk_pin: All layer numbers and rule values below were read from the PDK at sim/pdk.json pinned_commit f7bca32694fe3d58be0cc7d9df4b9f5db7161a14 (IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK, subtree ihp-sg13cmos5l). Paths in _citations are relative to pdks/ihp-open-pdk/ihp-sg13cmos5l/.

process._comment: Reproduces design/gen_netlists.py's SG13CMOS5L sizing constants (decision record 0003 keeps that generator local), so the layout draws the devices this repo already committed in design/netlists/. Verified device-for-device against design/netlists/s5l_inv_1.spice.

_citations.supply_v: design/gen_netlists.py VDD_V = 1.20; spec/target-spec.md 'Core supply' row (1.20 V, sg13_lv devices)
_citations.grid_nm: libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/rule_decks/sg13cmos5l_tech_default.json drc_rules.grid = 0.005 um. The generator's own default is 10 nm; SG13CMOS5L is a 5 nm grid.
_citations.device_params: design/netlists/s5l_inv_1.spice device line. {w} already expands with a unit suffix (740n), so w={w}n would render the malformed w=740nn.

layout._comment: Row geometry from spec/target-spec.md (ratified by decision record 0001): 3.36 um row of 8 x 0.42 um tracks, 0.42 um routing grid, Metal1-only intra-cell routing. row_height_nm is NOT relaxed here: the ratified fallback to 3780 nm is permitted only through a new decision record citing generator evidence, and belongs to issue #24.
layout._margin_budget: n_diff_y0_nm and p_diff_top_margin_nm are the only free parameters, and they decide whether the 3.36 um row places. Measured on s5l_inv_1 with this generator and these rules (see layout/README.md for the runs): n_diff_y0_nm >= 280 (below it the VSS tap Metal1 is not m1_space clear of Y), p_diff_top_margin_nm >= 260 (same constraint on the VDD tap), and n_diff_y0_nm + p_diff_top_margin_nm <= 750 (above it the channel is too short for track 1 of Y). 350/330 is the maximin point of that region: 70 nm of slack on each of the three constraints. Wider devices shrink the channel, so the sum is the number issue #24 will have to move.

_citations.row_height_nm: spec/target-spec.md Parameter table, 'Row height' target 3.36 um (8 tracks of 0.42 um)
_citations.gate_pitch_nm: spec/target-spec.md Parameter table, 'Routing grid' 0.42 um x 0.42 um; must be even (the generator puts node centres on half pitches)
_citations.channel_tracks: spec/target-spec.md 'Intra-cell routing' Metal1 only; one horizontal channel track, as the origin example
_citations.n_diff_y0_nm: no PDK rule; free parameter, see _margin_budget
_citations.p_diff_top_margin_nm: no PDK rule; free parameter, see _margin_budget
_citations.layers.nsd: libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/rule_decks/layers_def.drc:131 nsd_drw = get_polygons(7, 0). REQUIRED, not optional, at the pinned generator commit: it raises 'layout.layers.nsd is missing, so the n-well tap cannot be drawn as a well tie (the deck derives the tie as activ & nsd)'. See layout/README.md for why this reverses issue #151's AC8.
_citations.rules.poly_width_nm: Gat.a 'Min. GatPoly width' 0.13 um -- value sg13cmos5l_tech_default.json drc_rules.Gat_a; implemented drc/rule_decks/feol/5_8_gatpoly.drc:30
_citations.rules.poly_space_nm: Gat.b 'Min. GatPoly space or notch' 0.18 um -- drc_rules.Gat_b; implemented feol/5_8_gatpoly.drc:37
_citations.rules.poly_endcap_nm: Gat.c 'Min. GatPoly extension over Activ (end cap)' 0.18 um -- drc_rules.Gat_c; rule text drc/rule_decks/sg13cmos5l_maximal.drc:2015 (not implemented in the default deck's feol/beol rule files)
_citations.rules.poly_to_activ_nm: Gat.d 'Min. GatPoly space to Activ' 0.07 um -- drc_rules.Gat_d; implemented feol/5_8_gatpoly.drc:44
_citations.rules.cont_nm: Cnt.a 'Min. and max. Cont width' 0.16 um -- drc_rules.Cnt_a; implemented feol/5_14_cont.drc:33
_citations.rules.cont_space_nm: Cnt.b 'Min. Cont space' 0.18 um -- drc_rules.Cnt_b; implemented feol/5_14_cont.drc:40
_citations.rules.activ_enc_cont_nm: Cnt.c 'Min. Activ enclosure of Cont' 0.07 um -- drc_rules.Cnt_c; implemented feol/5_14_cont.drc:48
_citations.rules.poly_enc_cont_nm: Cnt.d 'Min. GatPoly enclosure of Cont' 0.07 um -- drc_rules.Cnt_d; implemented feol/5_14_cont.drc:73
_citations.rules.m1_width_nm: M1.a 'Min. Metal1 width' 0.16 um -- drc_rules.M1_a; implemented drc/rule_decks/beol/5_16_metal1.drc:30
_citations.rules.m1_space_nm: M1.b 'Min. Metal1 space or notch' 0.18 um -- drc_rules.M1_b; implemented beol/5_16_metal1.drc:37
_citations.rules.rail_width_nm: NOT a DRC rule. spec/target-spec.md 'Pin access' row: 'The rail is the baseline's: Metal1, 0.44 um wide, centered on the cell boundary'; design/gen_netlists.py RAIL_UM = 0.44. The origin example config's 160 (the M1 minimum) is deliberately NOT carried over.
_citations.rules.nwell_enc_pactiv_nm: NW.c 'Min. NWell enclosure of P+Activ not inside ThickGateOx' 0.31 um -- drc_rules.NW_c; rule text sg13cmos5l_maximal.drc:1912 (not implemented in the default deck's rule files)
_citations.rules.nwell_enc_nactiv_nm: NW.e 'Min. NWell enclosure of NWell tie surrounded entirely by NWell in N+Activ not inside ThickGateOx' 0.24 um -- drc_rules.NW_e; rule text sg13cmos5l_maximal.drc:1924 (not implemented in the default deck's rule files). This is the well-tie rule the generator's n-well tap needs.
_citations.rules.activ_space_nm: Act.b 'Min. Activ space or notch' 0.21 um -- drc_rules.Act_b; implemented feol/5_5_activ.drc:37
_citations.rules.sd_enc_activ_nm: pSD.c 'Min. pSD enclosure of P+Activ in NWell' 0.18 um -- drc_rules.pSD_c; rule text sg13cmos5l_maximal.drc:2047 (not implemented in the default deck's rule files)
